title: UneceProductBatchCertification
description:
The process of certifying that a certain product batch has passed performance and quality assurance tests, or
qualification requirements stipulated in regulations.

applicableStandard.description: A referenced standard applicable to this product batch certification.

assertion.description:
An assertion, expressed as text, for this product batch certification, such as a claim that this product is free from
gluten.

assertionCode.description:
The code specifying the assertion for this product batch certification, such as a claim that a product is free from
gluten.

relatedLocation.description: A referenced location related to this product batch certification.

responsibleAgency.description: An agency, expressed as text, responsible for this product batch certification.

specifiedAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion specified for this product batch certification.

standard.description: A standard, expressed as text, used for this product batch certification.
